summary_en: GMO Commerce raised its FY2026 year-end dividend forecast by 1.56 yen to 52.12 yen per share, based on upward revision of consolidated earnings guidance and application of its dividend policy targeting a payout ratio of 65% or DOE of 8% or higher.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision (Increase) of Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending December 2026
translation_en_brief:
GMO Commerce raised its year-end dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending December 2026 by 1.56 yen per share, from a previously announced 50.56 yen to 52.12 yen per share. The increase was decided by the board of directors on September 24, 2026, following an upward revision of the company's consolidated earnings forecast for the same period.

The dividend revision is based on the company's stated dividend policy, which targets a consolidated payout ratio of 65% or a consolidated return on equity (DOE) of 8% or higher, whichever is greater. The company emphasizes that the policy targets themselves remain unchanged, and that this increase reflects the application of existing standards to the improved earnings outlook.

The prior year-end dividend for the fiscal year ending December 2025 was 40.30 yen per share. No interim dividends are scheduled for any quarter of fiscal 2026.
